'''Hoverbike''' was a term used for [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It typically referred to a subset of speeders that required the [[Limb/Legends|bipedal]] operator to be in a standing position. [[Gurian]] was a manufacturer of hoverbikes.
